title: HR Administrator
description:
Are you a proactive and highly organised HR professional who thrives in a busy, fast-paced environment?

HR Administrator - Recruitment and Compliance

LVS Ascot, Ascot, Berkshire, SL5 8 DR

Competitive salary

Full time 35 hours per week 52 weeks per year

LVS Ascot is looking for a resilient, adaptable and highly organised HR Administrator to join its busy Human Resources team.

This is an important and varied position requiring someone who can confidently manage competing priorities, remain calm under pressure and maintain exceptional accuracy and confidentiality. You will need experience working in a fast-paced professional environment, together with a proactive approach and the confidence to take ownership of your workload.

About LVS Ascot

LVS Ascot is an independent, co-educational day and boarding school for pupils aged 4-19. The school provides a supportive and inspiring environment in which pupils are encouraged to develop academically and personally.

As part of the HR team, you will support employees working across the school s academic, pastoral, operational and boarding departments.

The role

Reporting to the Head of HR, you will provide efficient administrative support across recruitment, safer recruitment compliance, payroll and the full employee lifecycle.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Advertising vacancies and managing applications across recruitment platforms.
- Screening applications and supporting managers throughout shortlisting.
- Organising interviews, preparing interview packs and coordinating arrangements.
- Providing candidates with a professional and welcoming recruitment experience.
- Completing and recording pre-employment checks, including references, DBS and overseas checks where applicable.
- Maintaining the Single Central Register and other safeguarding records.
- Preparing contracts, offer letters and employment documentation.
- Coordinating inductions and maintaining probation, training and appraisal records.
- Updating HR systems and iSAMS accurately and promptly.
- Monitoring staff absence and supporting return-to-work procedures.
- Assisting with monthly payroll, including timesheets, starters, leavers and contractual changes.
- Producing HR reports and maintaining secure filing systems.

About you

You will be:
- Proactive and self-motivated, with a practical problem-solving approach.
- Resilient and adaptable, remaining calm and focused when priorities change.
- Highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
- Experienced in a busy, fast-paced administrative environment.
- Accurate and detail-focused, with strong written communication and proofreading skills.
- Warm, approachable and professional when dealing with candidates and colleagues.
- Able to handle confidential and sensitive information with complete discretion.
- Confident using Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint.
- Committed to safeguarding, equality, diversity and inclusion.

A good standard of education, particularly in English and Maths, is essential. Previous HR, recruitment, payroll, education or regulated-sector experience would be advantageous. CIPD Level 3, or working towards the qualification, would also be desirable.

This is a year-round position, providing essential HR support during term time and school holidays.

Safeguarding

LVS Ascot is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people. The successful applicant will be subject to an Enhanced DBS check, barred list checks, overseas checks where applicable and satisfactory professional references.

Please apply today - close date for applications Wednesday 7th October at 9am

title: HR and Recruitment Administrator
description:
An exciting opportunity for an experienced CIPD level 3 HR Recruitment Administrator to join a busy fast paced School HR team in Ascot, Berkshire. The HR Administrator is a key member of the Human Resources team, providing efficient administrative support in a busy, fast-paced environment. As an adaptable and resilient individual with excellent interpersonal skills, you will handle changing priorities calmly while maintaining total accuracy, discretion, and a warm, professional approach.
The successful candidate will:
- CIPD level 3
- Full cycle Recruitment and Candidate Experience
- Up to date with Compliance and Safeguarding
- working knowledge of HR Systems Management and Data
- Experienced in HR Administration and Lifecycle
- Payroll and Remuneration
- Continuing Professional Development (CPD)
- Year round working - This is a full-time, 52-week-per-year position. The postholder will be expected to work across the full calendar year rather than solely during the School's academic terms.

Working closely with the Head of HR and line managers, you will deliver a welcoming experience for candidates and staff. Primary responsibilities include end-to-end recruitment, Safer Recruitment compliance, payroll processing, and managing HR systems.

If you would like more information about this fantastic opportunity please contact Jo ASAP

title: HR Administrator
description:
Job Title: HR Co-Ordinator

Location: Reading
Working Pattern: Fully Office Based

Start Date: ASAP with interviews taking place on Monday afternoon onsite
Duration: Temporary for 6 months

Working Days and Hours: Monday - Friday, 9:00 am - 2:00 pm
Hourly Rate: 15.40 per hour

We are looking for an experienced HR administrator to come and join our clients team on temporary basis for 6 months. You will be taking on multiple duties, working alongside the HR Manager supporting and co-ordinating when required. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a close knit busy team.

Responsibilities include, however are not limited to:
- Manage all HR admin including scanning and organising documentation and contracts
- Assisting with all onboarding of new staff members
- Arranging and co-ordinating interviews with candidates
- Updating spreadsheets

To be considered for this role you must have previous experience working within a busy HR team, ideally between 2 - 3 years. You must have strong attention to detail, be a highly organised individual and be able to hit the ground running immediately.

Huntress Search Ltd acts as a Recruitment Agency in relation to all Permanent roles and as a Recruitment Business in relation to all Temporary roles.

We practice a diverse and inclusive recruitment process that ensures equal opportunity for all we work with, irrespective of race, sexual orientation, mental or physical disability, age or gender. As an organisation, we encourage applications from all backgrounds and will ensure measures are met when required, to allow a fair process throughout.

PLEASE NOTE: We can only consider applications from candidates who have the right to work in the UK.
